
#CD123, CD163 and PD-L1 correlation in HPV-I VSCC

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 0. CAPTURE EACH SCRIPT'S ihc_data UNDER ITS OWN NAME
# Run this right after finishing each script -- both scripts
# create an object called `ihc_data`
# ============================================================

ihc_data_cd123 <- ihc_data   # run right after the CD123 script

ihc_data_cd163 <- ihc_data   # run right after the CD163 script

stopifnot(exists("ihc_data_cd123"), exists("ihc_data_cd163"))

# Sanity check: confirm the compartment columns exist where expected
stopifnot(all(c("Case_ID", "Positive_cells_tumoral_area") %in% names(ihc_data_cd123)))
stopifnot(all(c("Case_ID", "Positive_cells_tumor_stroma") %in% names(ihc_data_cd163)))

# Confirm the continuous PD-L1 field actually exists under this name;
# if not, this prints the candidates so you can fix the name below.
if (!"pdl1_immune_cells_pos" %in% names(ihc_data_cd163)) {
  cat("`pdl1_immune_cells_pos` not found. Candidate columns:\n")
  print(grep("pdl1", names(ihc_data_cd163), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE))
  stop("Fix the continuous PD-L1 column name before continuing.")
}
```


```{r}
# =============================================================================
# CD123 / CD163 / PD-L1 CORRELATION AND OVERLAP - HPV-independent VSCC
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requires the IHC datasets created by the CD123 and CD163 scripts.
# At the END of each of those scripts, save them with:
#
  saveRDS(ihc_data, "ihc_data_cd123.rds")   # end of CD123 script
 saveRDS(ihc_data, "ihc_data_cd163.rds")   # end of CD163 script
#
# Reported in the manuscript (Results, CD163 section):
#   Spearman correlations among continuous CD123 (overall tumor area),
#   CD163 (overall tumor area) and PD-L1 (% immune cells), BH-FDR corrected,
#   in cases with all three markers available (n=42).
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(maxstat)
library(survival)
library(openxlsx)

ihc_data_cd123 <- readRDS("ihc_data_cd123.rds")
ihc_data_cd163 <- readRDS("ihc_data_cd163.rds")

# Sanity checks
stopifnot(all(c("Case_ID", "Positive_cells_tumoral_area") %in% names(ihc_data_cd123)))
stopifnot(all(c("Case_ID", "Positive_cells_tumoral_area",
                "pdl1_immune_cells_pos", "pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category")
              %in% names(ihc_data_cd163)))
```



```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 1. SPEARMAN CORRELATION (continuous measurements, n=42)
# =============================================================================

cor_data <- ihc_data_cd123 %>%
  select(Case_ID, CD123 = Positive_cells_tumoral_area) %>%
  inner_join(
    ihc_data_cd163 %>%
      select(Case_ID,
             CD163 = Positive_cells_tumoral_area,
             PD_L1 = pdl1_immune_cells_pos),
    by = "Case_ID"
  ) %>%
  drop_na(CD123, CD163, PD_L1)

cat("Cases with CD123, CD163 and PD-L1 available:", nrow(cor_data), "\n")  # 42

run_spearman <- function(data, var1, var2) {
  test <- cor.test(data[[var1]], data[[var2]], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  tibble(
    Marker_1     = var1,
    Marker_2     = var2,
    N            = nrow(data),
    Spearman_rho = unname(test$estimate),
    P_value      = test$p.value
  )
}

cor_results <- bind_rows(
  run_spearman(cor_data, "CD163", "PD_L1"),
  run_spearman(cor_data, "CD123", "CD163"),
  run_spearman(cor_data, "CD123", "PD_L1")
) %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH"))

cor_results
# Expected: CD163-PD-L1 rho=0.37, FDR=0.044
#           CD123-CD163 rho=0.02, FDR=0.898
#           CD123-PD-L1 rho=0.10, FDR=0.788
```



```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 2. MAXSTAT (DSS) CUT-OFFS - overall tumor area
#    Same definition as in the survival analyses: High = value > cut-off
# =============================================================================

find_maxstat_cutoff_ihc <- function(time_var, event_var, marker_var, data) {
  d <- data[!is.na(data[[marker_var]]) & !is.na(data[[time_var]]) &
              !is.na(data[[event_var]]), ]
  if (nrow(d) < 10) return(NA_real_)
  fmla <- as.formula(paste0("survival::Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var,
                            ") ~ ", marker_var))
  ms <- tryCatch(
    maxstat::maxstat.test(fmla, data = d, smethod = "LogRank", pmethod = "Lau92",
                          iscores = TRUE, minprop = 0.2, maxprop = 0.8),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(ms)) return(NA_real_)
  unname(ms$estimate)
}

cd123_cutoff <- find_maxstat_cutoff_ihc("time_death_surv_60m", "death_disease_60m",
                                        "Positive_cells_tumoral_area", ihc_data_cd123)
cd163_cutoff <- find_maxstat_cutoff_ihc("time_death_surv_60m", "death_disease_60m",
                                        "Positive_cells_tumoral_area", ihc_data_cd163)

cat("CD123 tumor-area cut-off (DSS):", cd123_cutoff, "\n")  # 30
cat("CD163 tumor-area cut-off (DSS):", cd163_cutoff, "\n")  # 15
```



```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 3. CD123 status within PD-L1 / CD163 groups (n=42)
#    (cross-tabulation reported in the response to Reviewer 2)
# =============================================================================

three_marker_data <- ihc_data_cd123 %>%
  select(Case_ID, CD123 = Positive_cells_tumoral_area) %>%
  inner_join(
    ihc_data_cd163 %>%
      select(Case_ID,
             CD163 = Positive_cells_tumoral_area,
             pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category),
    by = "Case_ID"
  ) %>%
  drop_na(CD123, CD163, pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category) %>%
  mutate(
    CD123_high = CD123 > cd123_cutoff,          # same rule as survival models
    CD163_high = CD163 > cd163_cutoff,
    PDL1_pos   = pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category == "Positive",
    PDL1_CD163_group = factor(
      case_when(
         PDL1_pos &  CD163_high ~ "PD-L1+ / CD163-high",
         PDL1_pos & !CD163_high ~ "PD-L1+ / CD163-low",
        !PDL1_pos &  CD163_high ~ "PD-L1- / CD163-high",
        !PDL1_pos & !CD163_high ~ "PD-L1- / CD163-low"
      ),
      levels = c("PD-L1+ / CD163-high", "PD-L1+ / CD163-low",
                 "PD-L1- / CD163-high", "PD-L1- / CD163-low")
    ),
    CD123_status = factor(ifelse(CD123_high, "CD123 high", "CD123 low"),
                          levels = c("CD123 low", "CD123 high"))
  )

cat("Cases with all three markers:", nrow(three_marker_data), "\n")  # 42

crosstab <- three_marker_data %>%
  count(PDL1_CD163_group, CD123_status, name = "N", .drop = FALSE) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = CD123_status, values_from = N, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total = `CD123 low` + `CD123 high`)

crosstab
cat("Grand total:", sum(crosstab$Total), "\n")
```
